name: sdl3-shadercross-macos
description: SDL_shadercross built on macOS (milestone 9 bis, part 2): the shadercross tool, which compiles the engine's HLSL to MSL on the Mac itself. HLSL goes through the DXC of the LunarG Vulkan SDK (vcpkg's directx-dxc has no macOS build), then SPIRV-Cross. NOT TRIED YET: written on Windows, to check at the next Mac session (moteur_doc/TEST_MAC.md).
